ref_text: The station is quiet in the afternoon. A fan turns, a pencil scratches on paper, and somebody down the corridor is asking for tea.

lines.text: You're the only one who saw the thief's face,
You don't know, so you guess.
Whoever you pick goes to jail.
If you chose number four, you chose the drawing, and so did the police: he's only here because he looks like it.
lines.text_kokoro: If you chose number four, you chose the [drawing](/dɹˈɔːɪŋ/), and so did the police: he's only here because he looks like it.

lines.text: If you chose number two, you were right, and nobody believed you: he looks nothing like the drawing.
lines.text_kokoro: If you chose number two, you were right, and nobody believed you: he looks nothing like the [drawing](/dɹˈɔːɪŋ/).

lines.text: So number four goes to jail for your two guesses, because a pencil cannot draw "not sure".
In nineteen eighty-four, a tip told police that Kirk Bloodsworth looked like their sketch.
lines.text_kokoro: In nineteen [eighty-four](/ˈAtifˌɔɹ/), a tip told police that Kirk [Bloodsworth](/blˈʌdzwəɹθ/) looked like their sketch.

lines.text: DNA freed him almost nine years later.
lines.text_kokoro: DNA freed him almost nine years [later](/lˈAtəɹ/).

lines.text: He's having chai beside a picture of your guesses.
lines.text_kokoro: He's having [chai](/ʧˈI/) beside a picture of your guesses.
